BEYOND THE CHART.

Research, data and systematic thinking behind a trading decision.

Our methods and capabilities. Research enquiries are scoped to your question and available data.

Explore our methods
Quantitative market research
Price behaviour, volume, volatility and trends examined through historical data.
Algorithmic strategy development
Explicit entry and exit rules, position sizing and conditions that can be tested.
Risk analysis
Drawdown, exposure, risk/reward and position limits considered together.
Backtesting & evaluation
Historical simulations with stated transaction costs, fill assumptions and outcome tracking.
Market intelligence
Financial news, catalysts and technical indicators organized into structured research.
